analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Day 2 of BUY Signal — The Gamma Squeeze Playbook Executed

Aug 20 is the confirmation session: the $70,000 gamma squeeze flagged in the Aug 19 dossier executed with textbook precision across four distinct phases.

### Session Map (Crypto.com 1H Candles — Aug 19 20:00 UTC → Aug 20 20:00 UTC)

**Phase 1 — Overnight Accumulation (Aug 19 21:00 – Aug 20 07:00 UTC)**
- Range: $68,902.60 (session low, 03:00 UTC) to $70,020.74 (high, 07:00 UTC)
- Volume: 37-273 BTC/h — patient, below-average; accumulation below $70,000
- The 07:00 UTC candle (36.8 BTC, high $70,020.74): the initial $70,000 probe; low volume = call-cover trigger without full cascade

**Phase 2 — The Gamma Squeeze (Aug 20 08:00 UTC)**

| Candle | Open | High | Close | Volume |
|--------|------|------|-------|--------|
| 08:00 UTC | $69,832 | **$71,817** | $71,583 | **225.6 BTC ($16.1M)** |

In one 60-minute window: $1,985 intraday range (open→high); 225.6 BTC — 3.2x the overnight average (~70 BTC/h); call-short covers at $70,000 compressed into a single candle. The $70,000 gamma cascade moved BTC from $69,832 to $71,817 as call sellers were forced to buy at market.

**Phase 3 — Post-Squeeze Consolidation (09:00-14:00 UTC)**
- Range: $71,500-$72,100
- Volume: 71-280 BTC/h — above average but not explosive; gains held, not distributed
- 12:00 UTC (216.3 BTC), 13:00 UTC (280.8 BTC), 14:00 UTC (223.9 BTC): institutional accumulation at $71,500-$72,000

**Phase 4 — US Session Extension (15:00-20:00 UTC)**
- 15:00 UTC: 331.3 BTC ($24M) — the largest candle by USD value; US-market-hours institutional momentum
- 16:00-20:00 UTC: $72,400-$73,083 range
- Reference close (20:00 UTC): $72,676.87 on 107.1 BTC

### Volume Analysis — Expansion Confirms the Breakout

| Phase | Period | Avg Vol/h | Total |
|-------|--------|-----------|-------|
| Overnight | 20:00-07:00 UTC | ~70 BTC/h | ~770 BTC |
| Gamma squeeze | 08:00 UTC | 225.6 BTC | 225.6 BTC |
| Post-squeeze | 09:00-14:00 UTC | ~190 BTC/h | ~1,145 BTC |
| Extension | 15:00-20:00 UTC | ~197 BTC/h | ~1,184 BTC |
| **Total** | | | **~3,825 BTC (~$272M)** |

Session volume ~39% above Aug 19 (~2,758 BTC). Volume expanding on a second consecutive up-day is the textbook confirmation of a sustained breakout, not a one-session blow-off.

### ★ Strongest Support — $70,000 (Gamma-Squeeze Absorbed, Now Demand Anchor)

1. The 08:00 UTC gamma squeeze (225.6 BTC, $16.1M) absorbed all call-side OI at $70,000 in a single candle — the defending supply is gone
2. $1.4B+ in Bitcoin shorts liquidated; the short-cover buyers at $70,000-$71,800 are now long at those levels — their break-even creates natural demand on pullbacks
3. $70,000 round number generates media coverage ('Bitcoin hits $70,000') that draws retail buying on dips
4. Mirrors the $65,000-$65,500 resistance-to-support transition (Aug 19): the pattern is established; the structural demand zone is now $70,000

### ★ Strongest Resistance — $75,000 (Round Number + Next Call-OI Concentration)

1. TradingKey's +17% from $72,000 implies ~$84,000 medium-term; $75,000 is the first major waypoint
2. Call sellers forced out of $70,000 at a loss are reselling $73,000-$75,000 calls to recoup premium — concentrated supply overhead
3. Today's intraday high $73,083 is just 1.3% below $73,500 — within one normal session of the $73,000 resistance
4. At $75,000, prior-ATH-era buyers (who bought near ATH at $100,000+ and are still underwater) may take profits on the rally toward their break-even levels

### What Would Change the Read

**Extend BUY HIGH:** $73,083 cleared on >300 BTC/h; Aug 20 ETF flows positive; $70,000 holds on any pullback.

**Monitor (not yet step-aside):** Close below $70,000 with declining volume — first signal the gamma squeeze didn't produce lasting support. Would not trigger step-aside but would require reassessment.

**Step-Aside:** Reference close below $65,000 (Condition 1 breach) OR most recent daily ETF flows negative (Condition 2 breach). Both must breach simultaneously.
